title: Main Engine Failure
briefing: The main descent engine has lost thrust and we cannot reach the planned landing site. Pick a new site we can still reach, fast.
catastrophe: The clock hits zero with no new target. The lander tumbles past every safe site and ends its mission in a silent, unplanned crater.

title: Solar Storm Warning
briefing: A burst of charged particles is heading our way and our current approach is no longer safe. We must divert to a new landing site right now.
catastrophe: The storm arrives while the crew is still deciding. Electronics fry, screens go dark, and the lander drifts away with no one at the controls.

title: Guidance Computer Reboot
briefing: The guidance computer has crashed and our planned site is off the table. We need a fresh landing site before it comes back online.
catastrophe: The computer reboots just in time to find no target. It chooses by itself, and the lander touches down on a boulder field.

title: Fuel Leak
briefing: A propellant line is leaking and we cannot fly to the original site. Choose a new landing site while we still have fuel to get there.
catastrophe: The tanks run dry before a site is chosen. The lander falls the last stretch without thrust and crumples into the regolith.

title: Comms Glitch
briefing: We have lost the link with mission control and the original site can no longer be confirmed. Pick a new landing site on your own, now.
catastrophe: No decision comes in and the silence stretches on. The lander lands blind, far from any help, and its mission ends in radio silence.
